hook.name: GlassHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Glass token launchpad pools that applies direction-dependent static LP fees (different rates for buying vs. selling the glass token), collects a ~20% protocol fee via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and includes an optional MEV-protection module that can temporarily raise fees for up to 2 minutes after pool creation.
